summary:
Re-verified the iteration-8 claimed fixes to the woodwork branch of /app/frontend/src/lib/colour.js (8-connected picker, min-area 0.0012, picks cap 8, glass-only enclosed-pick drop L>=45) in the REAL browser on /visualiser at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844, using freshly-regenerated 800x600 synthetic images (bare_margin=40 std, bare_margin=20 narrow) with THIN 7px window-frame strips (colours per spec: sky 180,205,225; wall 250,248,244; right wall 235,233,226; door 25,32,60; architrave 150,143,133; frame 45,42,38; glass 180,195,210; downpipe 45,42,38; ground 120,118,110).

OUTCOME: BOTH fixes have REGRESSED. The claimed 7/7 pass in the Node harness has NOT translated to the browser at 800x600 — the browser is now WORSE than iteration-7 on BOTH branches.

WOODWORK (desktop 1440x900, /tmp/test_house.jpg 800x600, fresh page, layer=woodwork, click Detect): the brush overlay is COMPLETELY EMPTY. Coverage sampled from the brush canvas is 0% on door, 0% on all four architrave sides, 0% on the door slab centre, 0% on all four window-frame strips, 0% on the glass pane, 0% on both walls, 0% on sky/ground/downpipe. The `colour-auto-status` element is empty (no 'Woodwork detected' text is shown), which means the detect returned NO picks at all. This is a HARD regression from iteration-7 where at least the glass was picked at 100%. Requirement (door >=40%, frames >=3% each, glass <=15%, walls <=15%) is FAILED on ALL FOUR clauses. Because the mask is empty, painting Anthracite + Generate produces zero visible change to the door/frames/glass (I did not sample RGB after because the mask is empty; a mask of 0 pixels cannot recolour anything).

WALLS (desktop 1440x900, same image, fresh page reload, layer=walls, click Detect): status text confirms 'Walls detected automatically'. But coverage is WORSE than iteration-7 on THREE clauses at once — the mask now paints main-wall (100%) AND glass (100%) AND downpipe (70%), while completely MISSING the right return wall (right_wall_top 0%, right_wall_bot 0%, both bare strips 0%). After Forest Green + Generate: main wall shifted to (169,186,150) ✓, right wall stayed unchanged at (236,233,226) ✗, GLASS was TINTED to (148,165,133) ✗, door/frame/sky/ground unchanged ✓. Requirement (main wall >=50%, right wall >=30%, 0% on sky/door/glass/frame/ground/downpipe) is FAILED on right-wall (0%) AND glass (100%) AND downpipe (70%). Iteration-7 had this branch fully passing on the standard image (main+right both painted, no glass/downpipe pollution) — the iteration-8 changes have broken it.

NARROW WALLS (/tmp/test_house_narrow.jpg, bare_margin=20): main_wall_L 100%, narrow_glass 97%, all four bare strips 0%, narrow_frame_top 0%, downpipe 81%, sky 0%. Same failure as iteration-7 plus now the downpipe is included as well.

MOBILE 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=innerWidth=390). Walls detect and woodwork detect show the SAME masks as desktop (main+glass+downpipe on walls, empty on woodwork), so the algorithm is broken identically at both viewports. Screenshot at the end of the mobile run confirms visually: the pink overlay covers the main left wall + the glass pane inside the window ring + the vertical downpipe strip, and does NOT cover the right return wall or the door.

REGRESSIONS — all PASS in fresh browser contexts: homepage title 'TMN Decorating & Maintenance | Painter & Decorator Plymouth' renders, admin@tmndecorating.co.uk / TMN-Admin-2026! -> /admin, customer@test.co.uk / password123 -> /account.

Net: the iteration-8 fixes at /app/frontend/src/lib/colour.js woodwork branch have (a) not fixed the woodwork frame-fragmentation problem, (b) taken the woodwork branch from 'picks glass only' to 'picks nothing at all' (empty mask), and (c) collaterally regressed the walls branch — it now drops the right return wall AND unions the glass + downpipe into the wall mask. The Node harness passing 7/7 at 800x600 does not reflect the real browser code path.

ui_bugs.issue: Woodwork auto-detect returns an EMPTY mask on the standard 800x600 synthetic (all sampled regions 0% coverage; colour-auto-status text is blank i.e. no 'Woodwork detected' message fires). Iteration-7 at least picked the glass at 100%; iteration-8 picks nothing. Painting Anthracite has no effect because the mask is empty. Fixes (8-connected picker, min-area 0.0012, picks cap 8, glass-drop rule) have made this branch strictly worse, not better.

Walls auto-detect on the standard synthetic now (a) MISSES the entire right return wall (right_wall_top/bot 0%, both bare margin strips 0%), (b) INCLUDES the glass pane at 100%, and (c) INCLUDES the downpipe at 70%. This is a REGRESSION vs iteration-7 which had both walls painted and no glass/downpipe pollution. Painting Forest Green tints the glass pane visibly ((180,195,210) -> (148,165,133)) which the visitor did not ask for.

On the 20px bare-margin variant, walls detect misses all four bare strips (0% each), still swallows the glass at 97%, and now also swallows the downpipe at 81%. Iteration-7 already had bare strips 0% + glass 100%; iteration-8 additionally includes the downpipe. Requirement 'glass <=15% in walls mask' is failed.

action_items: WOODWORK: on 800x600 the fresh detect now returns ZERO picks (colour-auto-status stays blank). Please instrument detectWallMask woodwork branch to log how many picks reach the min-area / wall-Lab gate / enclosed-pick drop, and check whether the 8-connected picker + 0.0012 min-area is now being over-filtered by the enclosed-pick drop (glass L>=45 rule) — likely the DOOR pick and the GLASS pick are both being dropped, leaving the picks array empty. In particular: if the door is picked and its bbox contains an even-smaller architrave-ring bbox, and the architrave gets marked 'enclosed', the code may then drop the door too. Suspect: enclosed-pick drop cascading.

WALLS: right return wall lost. Between iteration-7 (both walls detected) and iteration-8 (only main wall + glass + downpipe), the walls branch has regressed. Please check whether the picks cap increase (6->8) or the min-area drop (0.003->0.0012) leaked into the walls branch and now the walls picker keeps a glass pick + a downpipe pick and drops the right-return-wall pick on the 8-cap. Also check whether the enclosed-openings union rule is now firing on the glass regardless of the surrounding-wall thickness (both 40px and 20px margins are being unioned).

TEST HARNESS: the Node harness at /app/scripts/test_wall_detect.mjs claims 7/7 at 800x600 but the browser at 800x600 shows the branches broken. Please diff the code paths (image decode, colour space, min-area denominator) — the harness is not exercising the same code the browser is running. Consider having the harness open a headless browser and drive the actual React component instead of running colour.js directly under Node.
Consider a full 'Clear' between woodwork and walls detects in the UI to avoid layer-cross-contamination, and expose the internal picks list on window for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: detectWallMask WOODWORK branch: after iteration-8's changes, on the standard 800x600 synthetic the detect returns an empty picks array — worse than iteration-7 (which at least kept the glass). The '8-connected + 0.0012 min-area + glass-only drop' combination appears to be filtering out every candidate. Recommend adding a WOODWORK_MIN_PICKS=1 guarantee that at least preserves the darkest enclosed dark-vs-bright candidate rather than dropping it wholesale.

detectWallMask WALLS branch: has now regressed on the standard image — right return wall is dropped, glass and downpipe are unioned in. The claim that only the woodwork branch was touched does not hold in the built bundle; either walls shares state that was changed, or the fix is not the one running. Verify /app/frontend/src/lib/colour.js on disk vs the deployed bundle.

The enclosed-openings union used by the walls branch still swallows glass on BOTH 40px and 20px bare-margin cases, and now also swallows the downpipe. This union rule needs a 'the enclosure must be wall-coloured on all N sides within K px' guard that was recommended in iteration-7 and does not appear to be in effect.

Node harness at /app/scripts/test_wall_detect.mjs claiming 7/7 at 800x600 after the rebuild is misleading if the browser sees empty masks at the same resolution. Either the harness bypasses the walls-Lab gate / enclosed drop, or it uses different scaling. Add a real browser-driven regression before shipping.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-8 claims to have fixed the iteration-7 woodwork-picks-only-glass bug via 8-connected picker + min-area 0.0012 + glass-only enclosed-pick drop. In the browser at 800x600 the fix does NOT hold and additionally has broken the walls branch. Reproduce: python3 /tmp/gen_house.py to make /tmp/test_house.jpg, go to /visualiser at 1440x900, upload, click WOODWORK, click Detect — the brush canvas will show NO overlay (0% coverage everywhere, colour-auto-status stays blank). Then reload, upload same, click WALLS, click Detect — the overlay will cover only the main-left wall, the glass pane, and the downpipe; the right return wall will NOT be covered. Paint Forest Green -> Generate — the glass pane tints green. The Node harness at /app/scripts/test_wall_detect.mjs is NOT catching this. Regressions: homepage/admin/customer all fine in fresh contexts.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-8's woodwork fix package (8-connected picker, min-area 0.0012, picks cap 8, glass-only enclosed drop with L>=45) appears to be cascading the enclosed-pick drop across multiple picks on 800x600: the door pick and the glass pick get filtered by the same rule, leaving zero picks, hence an empty mask. Independently, either the picks cap increase or the min-area drop is bleeding into the walls branch causing (a) the right-return-wall pick to be evicted in favour of the smaller glass + downpipe picks, and (b) the enclosed-openings union to still swallow the glass regardless of surrounding-wall thickness. The Node harness continues to pass because it does not run the same enclosure/union code path — most likely the harness stubs out the enclosed-openings union or uses a different Lab gate.
